text: He also had a little bull pup. <break time="0.8s" /> Named Andrew Jackson. <break time="0.8s" /> Who looked lazy. <break time="0.8s" /> Until money was bet on him. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he became a different dog. <break time="0.8s" /> And in a fight. <break time="0.8s" /> He would grab the other dogs back leg. <break time="0.8s" /> And hold on. <break time="0.8s" /> But one day he met a dog. <break time="0.8s" /> That had no back legs. <break time="0.8s" /> So he had nothing to hold on to. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at Smiley. <break time="0.8s" /> With a broken heart. <break time="0.8s" /> The poor pup walked away. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon after that he died. <break time="0.8s" /> One day Smiley caught a frog. <break time="0.8s" /> And took it home to his back yard. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he spent three months. <break time="0.8s" /> Teaching it to jump. <break time="0.8s" /> He named the frog Daniel Webster. <break time="0.8s" /> And soon it could turn a somersault. <break time="0.8s" /> In the air like a doughnut. <break time="0.8s" /> He also taught the frog to catch flies. <break time="0.8s" /> And it could snap up any fly. <break time="0.8s" /> That came close enough. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiley said that all a frog needed was education. <break time="0.8s" /> And that with it. <break time="0.8s" /> A frog could do almost anything. <break time="0.8s" /> Though he was so gifted. <break time="0.8s" /> He was modest. <break time="0.8s" /> And on flat ground. <break time="0.8s" /> He could jump farther. <break time="0.8s" /> Than any frog you ever saw. <break time="0.8s" /> Smiley kept him. <break time="0.8s" /> In a little box with holes in it. <break time="0.8s" /> And sometimes he carried it into town. <break time="0.8s" /> To look for a bet.
